description: Erection of first floor rear extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P15(B), P16(B), P17(B) and P19(B), received 10/03/2021, and P01(A), P11(A), P12(A), P13(A), P14(A), P20(A) and Design and Access Statement, received 18/02/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - The door and window formed in the side elevations of the extension shall each be obscure glazed, with the window hinged to open inwards; neither opening shall be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
